theorem.wick_doob: For Q_{j,i}=G_{j,i}^{tensor 2}-Gamma_{j-1,i}, strict-past same-point fresh-noise centering gives E sum_j (B_{j+1}-B_j):Q_j/2 = E(B_{J+1}:Q_{J+1}-B_{j0}:Q_{j0})/2.
theorem.full_current: Adding the exact CC and mixed polarizations gives E sum_j(R_j^C+R_j^cross+R_j^{G,Wick})=E W_{J+1}-E W_{j0}, with the full finite-low boundary retained.
theorem.trace_restoration: The literal raw R-069 target differs from the Wick terminal form by one half sum_j Tr[(B_{j+1}-B_j)Gamma_{j-1}], exactly the R-066 summable covariance-trace channel.
theorem.transported_tail: Discrete Abel summation plus Gamma_{<j}=O(N_j), K_j=O(N_j^-2), orthogonal ranges, and a dyadic Hardy inequality pay the transported covariance tail with an arbitrary one-use control allocation and no sextic allocation.
theorem.endpoint_defect: The endpoint-curvature remainder obeys |epsilon_j|<=C_* integral |a_j|^2|G_j|^2 and is paid once by R-068/R-069.
theorem.terminal_equivalence: After those already controlled channels, R-069 (6.7) is equivalent to the terminal translated covariance-normal current coercivity theorem; Wick--Doob terminalization is not itself a lower bound.
theorem.retained_resolvent: The exact pointwise completion retains S_z=T_z(I+pT_z)^-1, pays Tr(T_z^2(I+pT_z)^-1) by the Hilbert--Schmidt/sextic budget, and leaves only the adapted centered-resolvent chaos.
theorem.adapted_no_go: For z(xi)=A 1_{|xi|<=a}, the centered scalar expectation is -a phi(a)A^2 and the retained-resolvent expectation remains -a phi(a)A^2/(1+pA^2); normal ordering does not center an adapted coefficient.
theorem.weighted_linear_split: The complete Q_II-weighted linear frame splits exactly as L_sym+L_Cartan. Existing fifth-moment current control pays L_Cartan; the pure-pp subchannel is -q11 sum_r <Delta(U^T S_r U),A^T S_r A> and is paid once through R-068. The production q11 factor and all three generators are essential. The non-pp part of L_sym is not claimed closed.
theorem.two_stage_successor: First prove the balanced H^{-1-kappa} model attribution for the non-pp symmetric linear-frame model and pay it once through R-068. Then prove the coupled full-Q_II nonlinear rational-frame/cross-square bound for R_shift, retaining the FTC coefficient remainder and terminal square jointly without Malliavin derivatives of the control.

successor: A13-CLASSII-NPC-CONE-MARTINGALE-INJECTION-BALANCE now has two exact non-circular stages: the non-pp balanced H^{-1-kappa} linear-frame model attribution in R-070 (8.6)-(8.8), then the coupled nonlinear rational-frame/cross-square inequality in (8.9)-(8.10), followed by finite-energy extension.
